svg.title: Architectural drawing
svg.desc: Elevation of a monumental front carved out of a rock cliff: a lower storey of six columns with a broken pediment and a central doorway, and an upper storey with a round pavilion (tholos) under a conical roof and urn between half-pediment wings, with a round close-up of the tholos. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
svg.text: SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard
geometric construction of this form; no external drawing
